note: The Production Scene number. A scene added on set after scene 2 in the script takes a leading letter — A2 — while a scene inserted into locked script pages takes a trailing one.

The unique camera configuration — geo-location, positioning, lens, or other camera settings. The first setup is the master setup and is not marked on the slate; each change advances the letter. I, O and S are often skipped because they can be misread as numerals when handwritten. A setup is specific to a Scene Descriptor: on a new scene the setup reverts to master even if nothing on the camera changed.

Starts at 1 and increments. Tied to the combination of Scene Descriptor and Setup — if either changes, numbering restarts at 1. SER marks a series of takes recorded without stopping the camera; PU marks a pickup, where only a specific part of a scene is shot.
